scope.excluded: The separate frontend/ manifest is not used by the configured root deployment.

result: Dependency security upgrades applied locally and verified; existing application and backend compilation defects still require separate work.

audits.interpretation: npm affected-package counts include transitive and inherited findings. Zero findings means no advisories reported by this scan, not proof of application security.

dependencyDecisions: Keep Express 4 and React 18; apply patched versions without a framework rewrite.
Use Firebase 12.19.0 for the existing Node 22 environment; Firebase 13 dependencies require Node 24.12 or newer.
Scope the @grpc/grpc-js override to @firebase/firestore, upgrading from its pinned 1.9 line to the patched 1.14.7 line. Firestore is not imported by this application.
Remove unused Swiper, bcryptjs, jsonwebtoken, node-cron, winston and their unused direct type packages. jsonwebtoken remains where required transitively.
Move js-yaml to backend development dependencies because it is used only by contract tests.
Update compatible transitive packages, including Socket.IO parsers, Engine.IO, ws, proxy-addr, and build/lint dependencies.
compatibilityChanges: Migrate Firebase Admin auth, app initialization and messaging to modular APIs.
Set projectId when initializing Firebase from service-account JSON so the existing verification branch runs.
Update Zod record validation for JSON preferences.
Limit multipart requests to one file and no extra fields; return 413 for oversized files and 400 for other Multer limit errors.
Use ESM Vitest configuration and separate isolated unit tests from database-backed integration tests.
Configure Node 22 in the backend Dockerfile and frontend Nixpacks build; deployment installs use npm ci.

coverageAreas: multipart upload storage, resizing, limits, auth and cleanup
Firebase service-account JSON verification, invalid tokens and push client
Socket.IO WebSocket and polling delivery plus access checks
backendUnit.limitation: Database, external Firebase token verification, push delivery and Judge dependencies are mocked. These are not end-to-end production service tests.

warnings: existing NODE_ENV=production entry in a Vite environment file

databaseIntegration.reason: Existing integration helpers delete database fixtures using the configured environment; no isolated test database was provisioned.

remainingPriorities.task: Fix existing backend compilation defects: missing Judge Prisma models (including the chat send path), Stripe typings and geocoding response typing. The current build script masks TypeScript failure with || true.
Make production authentication fail closed when Firebase configuration is absent or invalid; the demo fallback still exists.
Enforce file ownership and safe paths in upload deletion; enforce membership checks for typing and read receipt events; resolve privacy issues from the original review.
Resolve existing lint findings and split the large initial frontend bundle.
Run integration and live-service validation against isolated staging services before release.
